comment: Every file in this directory except manifest.json is a launcher.json fixture. schema: the expected verdict against schemas/launcher.schema.json (Ajv2020, strict false) and the C# reader. bash: whether the SL-1 bash reader accepts or refuses it (it refuses unknown keys, unknown placeholders and wrong JSON types for the fields it uses, spec section 4; the rest it leaves to sindri launch show). A file that does not parse is invalid and refused.

fixtures.note: only the required key: every default applies
print viewer, tmux host
warp viewer
none host with an exec-template viewer that owns processes
the spec section 4 example
a placeholder inside an argument (--title={title})
an added agent that reports its id (hook absent: newestFile fallback)
an added agent with only the required fields
overrides name only the fields they change
meta lane agents
unknown key at the top level (terminal, not viewer)
print takes no name
unknown key under host
unknown key under an agent
unknown key under meta
{titel} is not in the closed placeholder set
{prompt} is not in the closed placeholder set
argv is a string, not an array
schema is a string
agents is an array, not an object
override is a string, not a boolean
lanes is an array, not an object
claude-code is built in: add "override": true (SND-LAUNCH-011); the bash reader does not know the catalog and promises less

exec-template needs name (the UI label); a value check beyond the bash promise
exec-template needs argv

agent ids match ^[a-z][a-z0-9-]{1,31}$

usage names built-in readers only
